messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

We should first provide a brief summary of Inception. Then we can call the function for Inception with extra_info true. Then call the function for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. The function only accepts one title per call. So we need two calls. We could do them sequentially. The best approach: Provide brief, then call function for Inception with extra_info true, then call function for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. Or maybe we can ask the function twice.
